description:
Request every document-reference path of a validation capture round in one batch, and apply the base capture requests once per capture rather than once per round.

## Background

- `discover_document_references` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:932-945`) calls `discover_paths` once per document reference and `discover_pinned` once per pin; it runs inside `grow_discovering` (`:235-237`), which runs the closure once more after the last extension, so discovery runs twice per validation.
- `DocumentReferenceRequests::for_reference` (`crates/jit/src/document/reference.rs:70-81`) is pure, so a round's requests can be computed before any is added.
- The `discover` closure in `capture_proposed_base_inner` re-applies `base(spec)` on every round (`:430-434`) and returns early when that changed the spec; `base` is already applied before the first capture when no start image is given (`:504-510`).
- Round-count tests over `counted_session` live at `commands/validate.rs:3530-3600`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `discover_document_references` adds a round's worktree paths through one `discover_paths` call and adds each pin once.
- [hard] REQ-02: The base requests are applied once per capture, before the first round or to the start image's spec, and the `discover` closure no longer re-applies them.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing capture and round-count suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation capture requests a round's document references as one batch
